lobby.invite: 📲 Everyone plays on their OWN phone: tap Invite in the top bar, send the link, and friends appear here as they open it.
lobby.title: One word each. No collisions. 💡
lobby.text: The whole room sees a mystery word — except the guesser. Everyone secretly writes ONE one-word clue on their phone… and identical clues CANCEL OUT before the guesser sees them. You win or lose together: 13 words.
clue.eyes: Eyes on your friends, not their phones
clue.writing: They're writing clues for you… {have}/{need} in.
clue.locked: Clue locked in ({have}/{need}). If someone wrote the same one, both vanish!
clue.show: All clues in → show the guesser
clue.isWord: That IS the word — nice try 😄
guess.yours: Your clues — say your guess OUT LOUD
guess.cancelled: …every clue cancelled out. Ouch. Good luck!
guess.no: ❌ Wrong (lose this word AND the next)
